evidence_pointer.ref: no return-related tool call in step 1 or later

reason: The agent states an intent to initiate a return process, but the only tool call made is amazon__show_cart, which does not execute the stated intent. There are no return-related tool calls in the same or following steps.
Step 1 amazon__show_cart returned status="success" along with the cart_items array, confirming the successful retrieval of the cart items.
The step 1 amazon__show_cart result lists all cart_items, and none of the product_name fields match H&M Turtleneck Sweaters.
